notes.title: Schrödinger's Equation for Dummies, Part I: Historical Overview
notes.summary: From Newton and Huygens arguing about light, through the double slit, the ultraviolet catastrophe, Planck, Einstein, Bohr and de Broglie, to the question Schrödinger set out to answer.

notes.title: Schrödinger's Equation for Dummies, Part II: Decoding the Equation
notes.summary: Builds the equation from a plain sine wave: amplitude, phase and wavelength, why complex numbers are needed to describe rotation, and how the energy operator falls out of the wave function.
